name: VC Trader AI Recall Market Frames
description: Read-only workspace-scoped tool: recall past market context frames similar to the one a symbol is in now, from the Market Context Frame store (symbol + anchor timeframe). Calls the propfirm_manager BFF as the workspace owner (PFM_AGENT_TOKEN). READ_ONLY per ADR 0078. Ships in SHADOW: the server decides whether frames may be returned, and says so in the envelope.
